subject: At the moment it's just
author: Cube
body: At the moment it's just Sonic Unleashed in terms of games for Christmas.

subject: You probably won't like
author: Cube
body:
You probably won't like Unleashed if you don't get on with 3D Sonic. I loved the 2 Adventures as well as Secret Rings and from the demo I'll love Unleashed.

As for other platformers I've completed Nuts & Bolts and XBLA Banjo-Kazooie and I should be getting Tomb Raider tomorrow.

subject: Sonic Unleashed
author: ZombieTron
body:
I nearly got this on Sunday in Gamestation.. they are selling it for £19.99... deal of the week. (I love a bargain!)

but, I never fully got on with Sonic in 3D and don't think I can bring myself to play...

Let me know what you think of it when/if you do get it tho..

My platform playing side is currently being satisfied with Banjo-Kazooie, after being neglected for way too long! 🙂
